## Adopted from Daniel Schulz 

This script can be used to calculate signal to noise ratios for single cells from an images.

As an input an expression matrix will work (e.g. steinbock output)

additionally we will load iamges and masks and investigate the positive and negative clusters on images


```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)
set.seed(22) #set global seed
```

```{r, message=FALSE}
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(imcRtools)
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(dittoSeq)
library(S4Vectors)
library(scater)
library(cowplot)
library(scales)
library(rlang)
library(data.table)
```

here we define a function that takes as an input:
- object: an sce object
- markers: character vector of markers found in the sce object
- group.by: a character string that defines the variable in the colData of the sce object to split groups by

```{r}
SN_ratios <- function(object,markers, group.by){
  cur_dat <- data.table(t(assay(object[markers,],"exprs")))
  cur_dat[, as_name(group.by) := sce[[group.by]]]
  cur_dat <- melt.data.table(cur_dat,measure.vars = markers, variable.factor = FALSE)
  cur_dat[, cluster := kmeans(value,centers = 2)$cluster, by = c(group.by,"variable")]
  cur_dat[, expr := mean(value), by = c(group.by,"variable", "cluster")]
  cur_dat <- as_tibble(dcast(cur_dat,formula = paste0(group.by,"+variable~cluster"),value.var = "expr", fun.aggregate = mean))
  colnames(cur_dat) <- c(group.by,"marker","cluster_1","cluster_2")
  cur_dat <- cur_dat %>%
    mutate(pos_cluster = ifelse(cluster_1 > cluster_2,cluster_1,cluster_2)) %>%
    mutate(neg_cluster = ifelse(cluster_1 > cluster_2,cluster_2,cluster_1)) %>%
    mutate(SN = pos_cluster/neg_cluster) %>%
    select(!c(cluster_1,cluster_2)) %>%
    arrange(marker)
  
    return(cur_dat)
}
```

# Application for RCC - myeloid panel titration

```{r}
sce <- read_steinbock("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_titration/", graphs_folder = NULL, return_as = "sce")

# panel and image information
panel <- read_csv("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_titration/panel.csv")
images <-  read_csv("/mnt/rcc_volume/RCC/IMC/myeloid_titration/images.csv")

# add dilution identifier
images$sample_id <- str_split(images$image, ".tiff", simplify = TRUE)[,1]
sce$dilution_id <- images$acquisition_description[match(sce$sample_id, images$sample_id)]
sce$dilution <- str_split(sce$dilution_id, "_", simplify = TRUE)[,1]

# check that panel and rowData from sce match
identical(rownames(sce),panel$name)

# add arcsinh transformed counts
assay(sce,"exprs") <- asinh(counts(sce)/1)

# add clean target names to sce object
rowData(sce)$clean_target <- rownames(sce) <- panel$clean_target

# update colnames of sce
colnames(sce) <- paste0(sce$sample_id, "_", sce$ObjectNumber)

#define markers for titration testing (markers that are apparent on most dilutions)
#rowData(sce)$use_channel <- 
rowData(sce)$use_markers <- !rowData(sce)$clean_target %in% c("cleavPARP","CD303","CCL19","CD370","CCL21","CXCL12","DC_LAMP","CD56","CD209","panCK","131Xe","134Xe","136Ba","138Ba", "DNA1","DNA2")
use_markers <- rowData(sce)$clean_target[rowData(sce)$use_markers]
```

## UMAP 

```{r}
# define the markers of interest
cluster_markers <- use_markers[!use_markers == "H3"]

# calculate and plot UMAP
sce <- runUMAP(sce,exprs_values = "exprs", subset_row = cluster_markers)

plotReducedDim(sce,dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "dilution_id")
```

## calculate signal to noise and check splits

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
sn_dat <- SN_ratios(sce,use_markers,group.by = "dilution_id")
``` 

here we check if the kmeans clustering actually does a meningful separation of cells into two clusters. we do this visually on the UMAP

```{r, fig.width=8, fig.height=4}
marker <- "CA9"
cur_dat <- as.matrix(t(assay(sce,"exprs"))[,marker])
cur_df <- as_tibble(colData(sce))
cur_df$expr<- cur_dat[,1]
clust_vec <- kmeans(cur_dat,centers = 2)
sce$clust_test <- as.factor(clust_vec$cluster)
p1 <- plotReducedDim(sce,dimred = "UMAP", colour_by = "clust_test")
p2 <- plotUMAP(sce, colour_by = marker, by_exprs_values = "exprs", 
                          point_size = 0.25, point_alpha = 1)+
  scale_colour_gradient(low = "white",high = "darkred", limits = c(0, 4))
  
plot_grid(p1,p2)
```

## plot signal to noise per marker

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=8}
colors <- c("positive_cluster" = "black", "negative cluster" = "gray","signal to noise" = "red")
ggplot(sn_dat)+
  geom_point(aes(x=dilution_id,y=pos_cluster, color="positive cluster"))+
  geom_point(aes(x=dilution_id,y=neg_cluster,col="negative cluster"))+
  geom_point(aes(x=dilution_id,y=SN,col="signal to noise"))+
  facet_wrap(.~marker, scales = "free")+
  labs(x="samples",
       y="Intensity [arcsinh] and signal to noise",
       color="Legend")+
  scale_color_manual(values = colors) +
  theme(axis.text = element_text(angle = 90))
```


# investigate pos and neg clusters on images

```{r load images and masks}
library(cytomapper)
masks <- cytomapper::loadImages("X:/raw_data/Panel_2/IMC/20210831_IMC_panel2_test/masks")
images <- cytomapper::loadImages("X:/raw_data/Panel_2/IMC/20210831_IMC_panel2_test/img")
channelNames(images) <- rownames(sce)
# sample_id in the sce and names of the images match
unique(sce$sample_id)
names(images)
mcols(images)$sample_id <- names(images)
mcols(masks)$sample_id <- names(masks)
mcols(masks)
# scale the masks
masks <- scaleImages(masks, 2^16-1)
```

## images of 012 dilution

```{r, fig.height=10, fig.width=10}
cur_sce <- sce["CD3",]
p.list <- list()
for (i in unique(sce$sample_id)) {
      cur_dat <- as.matrix(t(assay(cur_sce,"asinh"))[,i])
      cur_df <- as_tibble(colData(cur_sce))
      cur_df$expr<- cur_dat[,1]
      
      clust_vec <- kmeans(cur_dat,centers = 2)
      cur_df$cluster <- clust_vec$cluster
      
     high_clust <- as.vector(cur_df %>%
       select(cluster,expr) %>%
       group_by(cluster) %>%
       mutate(mean_exp = mean(expr)) %>%
       select(cluster, mean_exp) %>%
       distinct() %>%
       ungroup() %>%
       top_n(n = 1,wt = mean_exp) %>%
       pull(cluster))
     
    cur_sce$cluster <-  cur_df %>%
       mutate(pos_clust = ifelse(cluster == high_clust,paste0("high_",i),paste0("low_",i))) %>%
       pull(pos_clust)
    
    cur_masks <- getImages(masks,grepl("20210831_IMMUcan_Panel2_test2_SCCHN_MD_001",names(masks)))
    cur_images <- getImages(images,grepl("20210831_IMMUcan_Panel2_test2_SCCHN_MD_001",names(images)))
    cur_images <- cytomapper::normalize(cur_images,inputRange = c(0,5))
    plotPixels(image = cur_images,mask = cur_masks,object = cur_sce[,cur_sce$cluster == paste0("high_",i)],cell_id = "ObjectNumber",
               img_id = "sample_id",colour_by = i, outline_by = "cluster")
  
      
}
```
